title: A Warm Welcome
description: Walk over to the tavern and talk to Hollis, the innkeeper.

giver.name: Journal
giver.text: Skyhaven. A village on a cloud, higher than anyone sensible would build one. The air is clean, the lanterns are lit, and for the first time in a long while you are in no hurry.

objectives.label: Talk to Hollis Barrowmead, the Tavern Keeper
